name: @intelligence/llm-model-gateway
description: Multi-vendor bounded LLM co-pilot gateway for IntelligenceOS - single-file provider abstraction with free-tier failover. Deterministic warehouse data remains the sole analytical truth; this package only rewrites, rephrases, or restates, never decides or invents.
